subject: Social Media
title: The Censorship Debate
description: A quick win: understand The Censorship Debate.

hook.text: Twitter banned a sitting president. Half the country cheered. Half called it tyranny. Both had valid arguments.

buildup.text: Free speech absolutists say no private company should control public discourse. It concentrates too much power.

discovery.text: Pragmatists argue unmoderated platforms become cesspools. Gab and Parler showed: total freedom attracts extremists.

twist.text: The paradox of tolerance: unlimited free speech enables those who would destroy free speech. Freedom eats itself.

climax.text: No society has ever allowed absolute speech. The question isn't whether to moderate but who decides the lines.

punchline.text: The debate isn't free speech vs censorship. It's who holds the pen.

quiz.question: What does the paradox of tolerance describe?
options: Unlimited freedom enables those who destroy freedom
